$description: Squash & Stretch tokens - Disney's first principle of animation. Defines volume-preserving deformation for organic, lifelike motion.

squash-stretch.$description: Scale factors for squash and stretch deformation. Volume preservation: scaleX * scaleY = 1

subtle.$description: Minimal deformation for professional UI. Use for buttons, icons, micro-interactions. Brand attitude: elegant, refined.

medium.$description: Standard deformation for cards, modals, notifications. Brand attitude: friendly, approachable.

expressive.$description: Pronounced deformation for playful, emphasis moments. Brand attitude: playful, energetic, gaming.

impact.$description: Maximum squash for landing, collision, heavy impacts. Stretch is neutral - object compresses on impact.

bounce.$description: Bounce sequence with multiple oscillations. For rubber-ball-like rebounds.

elastic.$description: Elastic material simulation. High stretch, moderate squash. For jelly, rubber UI elements.

axis-alignment.$description: Squash/stretch axis relative to motion direction

perpendicular.$description: Disney standard: squash perpendicular to motion direction, stretch along motion axis.

radial.$description: For circular/orbital motion: squash toward center, stretch along tangent.

quick-impact.$description: Fast impact with long settle. Ball drop, button press.

balanced.$description: Even distribution for general purpose bounce.

slow-motion.$description: Extended phases for dramatic, slow-motion reveals.
